title: Escalation evidence optimizer and Slack thread compiler
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: PagerDuty alerts routinely generate noisy pages with long trace links, raw logs, and multiple dashboards. On-call engineers spend time stitching context into Slack threads and manually pulling runbook snippets for remediation. We need a pipeline component that automatically curates a compact, prioritized evidence bundle and posts it into a single Slack thread or thread attachment, and also annotates the PagerDuty incident with concise remediation hints and links.
goals: Compile top 3 correlated traces, a latency histogram snapshot, and a representative log sample into a human-readable Slack thread card
Attach runbook snippets (steps 1-3) relevant to the detected symptom using runbook index tags
Annotate the PagerDuty incident with a short mitigation summary and a link to the compiled evidence bundle
Ensure the pipeline respects SLO for generation latency (<= 6s for page augmentation) and rate-limits to avoid noisy pages
constraints: No PII should be included — scrub traces/logs using existing redaction rules
Payload size to Slack must remain under 12 KB per posted block; fallback to an S3/Drive bundle when exceeded
Must integrate with existing tracing hooks (trace IDs and KV cache context) without adding blocking latency to serving runtime
acceptance_criteria: When a PagerDuty alert fires, a Slack thread is created or appended with a single curated evidence card within 6s of alert creation

Curated card includes: incident summary, 3 trace links ranked by error/latency score, latency histogram image or link, 5-line representative log sample with scrubbed values, and top runbook snippet (steps and rollback hint)
PagerDuty incident gets a short annotation with mitigation hint and link to the evidence bundle
Fallback storage link is created and accessible if Slack payload size exceeded; link appears in thread and PD annotation
Automated tests cover redaction rules, size fallback behavior, and correctness of runbook snippet selection
tasks: Design: finalize evidence card schema (fields, markdown format, image vs link decision) — owner: Aisha
